newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-NOVOTNA HUMBLES SELES IN MADRID FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-NOVOTNA HUMBLES SELES IN MADRID FINAL.

text.p: Czech Jana Novotna completed a stunning 7-5 6-1 victory over top seed Monica Seles in the Madrid Open final on Saturday.
Second seed Novotna trailed 5-3 in the first set but turned the match around by winning eight successive games. Seles never recovered.
"I played very intelligently and she made more errors than normal," Novotna said after retaining her title.
Seles said had lacked concentration and missed many opportunities to break Novotna's serve.
Seles lost service seven times and in the last four games of the first set she was only able to win four points.
Both players needed treatment from a WTA physiotherapist during the match -- Novotna for a pulled muscle in her left thigh and Seles for a strain in her heel.
